summary: Agristo is a Belgian family business that makes frozen potato products, mainly fries, at sites including a plant in Tilburg, Netherlands, bought in 2001. The group is headquartered in Wielsbeke, Belgium, and was founded in 1986. It reports 950,000 tonnes of finished product in 2025.
products: Frozen fries, including premium fries and special cuts
Private label frozen potato products for retail
Custom signature fries for clients' brands
markets: France and Germany were the first export markets in 1987
facts: Group: 950,000 tonnes of finished product in 2025
Works with 800 growers in Belgium, the Netherlands, France and Germany
Tilburg BRC certificate valid to 27 March 2027
limitations: Capacity, tonnage, line count, employee numbers, products and markets for the Tilburg plant are not published on the pages read.
The Tilburg plant's own address, phone and email are not published; contact details are for the Wielsbeke head office.
